name: Uesugi Fuutarou
source:
A blunt, friendless high school student that is very academically gifted. Fuutarou lives with his sister and father in a small apartment. He is serious and dedicated to his efforts in helping the Nakano sisters improve their grades. He likes dishes that his sister Raiha cooks, but hates raw fish. His favorite drink is barley tea, his favorite animals are gorillas and his daily convention is storing one coin.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_The_Quintessential_Quintuplets_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
